title: Integrating AIRL-Based Reward Estimation into a Control Method Using Fuzzy Inference and Policy Gradient
abstract: arXiv:2610.14723v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A method integrating policy gradient with fuzzy inference has been proposed. This method, hereafter referred to as the base model, has high flexibility with respect to the configuration of fuzzy inference rules and fuzzy representation. It can also automatically adjust the rule weights and the membership functions in the antecedent and consequent parts using the same framework for learning. In methods that integrate reinforcement learning with fuzzy inference, however, the reward function must be designed in advance. It is therefore useful to add learning-based reward estimation to the base model. This paper proposes a fuzzy control method that integrates a reward estimation mechanism based on the adversarial inverse reinforcement learning (AIRL) framework into the base model. translated_title: 将基于AIRL的奖励估计集成到使用模糊推理与策略梯度的控制方法中
translated_abstract: 已有研究提出了一种将策略梯度与模糊推理相结合的方法。该方法（以下简称基础模型）在模糊推理规则和模糊表示的配置方面具有很高的灵活性，并且能够使用统一的学习框架自动调整规则权重以及前件和后件部分的隶属函数。然而，在将强化学习与模糊推理相结合的方法中，奖励函数必须预先设计。因此，在基础模型中加入基于学习的奖励估计是有益的。本文提出了一种模糊控制方法，将基于对抗逆强化学习（AIRL）框架的奖励估计机制集成到基础模型中。然而，AIRL所采用的生成对抗网络（GAN）框架往往存在学习不稳定的问题。为解决这一问题，所提出的方法将……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将基于对抗逆强化学习（AIRL）的奖励估计机制集成到模糊推理与策略梯度相结合的控制方法中，从而免除了预先设计奖励函数的需要，并试图缓解GAN框架学习不稳定的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fuzzy control method that integrates AIRL-based reward estimation into a fuzzy inference and policy gradient control framework, eliminating the need for pre-designed reward functions while addressing the learning instability of the GAN framework.
